# Expected changes for "Infestations" update (patch 68) on June 2nd, 2026

![Expected changes for `Infestations` Update (Patch 68) on June 2nd, 2026](/uploads/704_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Another content update is just around the corner. The **"Infestation" update (patch 68)** awaits you on June 2nd, 2026, which brings new game mechanics and some other changes. There are also new blueprints, new challenges, new fish and other changes.

## Index

## Infestations / Infestations

The central new feature in Patch 68 is Infestations. Infestations are not an event or an activity as you know it. It is a dynamic system that replaces normal enemies with stronger enemies in up to 5 locations (out of 52). There is a boss and many enemies to support him. The strength of these enemies has been reduced over the course of the PTS, so they will probably be fairly easy to defeat in the live version, even though they can be up to level 200.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-infestation-radius-capture-morgantown.jpg)

The enemies in an infestation have no stars, but they all have a chance to drop legendary items. The supporters have a **10-20%** chance to drop **legendary 3-star** items and the **boss** gives you a **4-star** item with a **100%** chance. In addition, the boss also drops surprise bobblehead boxes, surprise magazine packs, treasure maps, salvage and storage kits, legendary modules & notes, mutation serums, chems, scrap and much more. 

All details and all **new 4 star mods** can be found in the post & video:

## Seasonal fish

The seasonal fish are only available in certain regions during a certain season. However, they are all “unusual” fish that are relatively easy to catch.

The prerequisite is of course the completed fishing quest in Angler`s Ruh with the captain.

Best drop chance given here applies to unusual fish with first-class bait. Even with normal and improved baits you will often catch these fish.

## New local legend

There is also a new local legend, the "**Glass Spirit**", not only is this difficult to catch and **can only be found in the "Glass Cave"** in **Cranberry Bog**. In addition, its rarity is limited to one season; the "Glass Spirit" can only be found there in summer.

More about this in the article:

## New recipes

### Fish in aspic

Can be learned by completing the "Catch a Summer Regional Legend: Glass Spirit" challenge.

**Effects:**

- TP: 0.80 TP/s over 25 sec.
 - Carnivore: 1.6TP/s
- INT: +4 for 1 hour.
 - Carnivore: +8 INT (+10 INT with "Odd by the Dozen")

**Ingredients:**

- 3x wood
- 1x boiled water
- 2x Deathclaw Egg
- 2x carrot
- 5x summer fillet

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-seasonal-fish-recipe-jellied-fish.jpg)

## Wasteland Fish Sandwich

Learned when catching a seasonal fish.

**Effects:**

- TP: 0.80 TP/s over 25 sec.
 - Carnivore: 1.6TP/s
- Movement speed: +20% for 1 hour.
 - Carnivores: +40% (+50% with "By the Dozen Strangers")

**Ingredients:**

- 1x wood
- 1x cooking oil
- 1x blade grain flour
- 1x summer fillet

![Wasteland Fish Sandwich](/uploads/nukaknights-post-seasonal-fish-recipes-wasteland-sandwich.jpg)

## New mods for the light machine gun

There were never any mods for the LMG (MG42), except for the first-class bolt. Finally the time has come. With Patch 68, the light machine gun now receives 13 mods that other weapons have had for a long time.

Here is the list of all new mods for the light machine gun:

- Critical .308 bolt
- Critical .45 bolt
- Calibrated shutter
- Fast magazine
- Large Magazine (Learned by Scrapping)
- Piercing magazine
- Ze
